package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

const LearningAnalyticsStream = "LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS"

type InterestingActivityPublisher struct {
	connection *natsgo.Conn
	jetstream  natsgo.JetStreamContext
	timeout    time.Duration
}

func NewInterestingActivityPublisher(url string, timeout time.Duration) (*InterestingActivityPublisher, error) {
	url = strings.TrimSpace(url)
	if url == "" || timeout <= 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("nats url and positive publish timeout are required")
	}
	connection, err := natsgo.Connect(url, natsgo.Timeout(timeout))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	jetstream, err := connection.JetStream(natsgo.PublishAsyncMaxPending(64))
	if err != nil {
		connection.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	return &InterestingActivityPublisher{connection: connection, jetstream: jetstream, timeout: timeout}, nil
}

func (publisher *InterestingActivityPublisher) PublishInterestingActivity(ctx context.Context, activity domain.InterestingActivity) error {
	if publisher == nil || publisher.jetstream == nil || activity.EventID == uuid.Nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("interesting activity publisher is not configured")
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		SchemaVersion int                        `json:"schema_version"`
		EventID       string                     `json:"event_id"`
		EventType     string                     `json:"event_type"`
		CorrelationID string                     `json:"correlation_id"`
		StudentID     string                     `json:"student_id"`
		OccurredAt    time.Time                  `json:"occurred_at"`
		Data          domain.InterestingActivity `json:"data"`
	}{
		SchemaVersion: 1, EventID: activity.EventID.String(), EventType: domain.InterestingActivitySubject,
		CorrelationID: activity.AnalyticsSessionID.String(), StudentID: activity.StudentID.String(),
		OccurredAt: activity.OccurredAt.UTC(), Data: activity,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	message := natsgo.NewMsg(domain.InterestingActivitySubject)
	message.Data = payload
	message.Header.Set(natsgo.MsgIdHdr, activity.EventID.String())
	publishCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, publisher.timeout)
	defer cancel()
	_, err = publisher.jetstream.PublishMsg(message, natsgo.Context(publishCtx), natsgo.ExpectStream(LearningAnalyticsStream))
	return err
}

func (publisher *InterestingActivityPublisher) Close() {
	if publisher != nil && publisher.connection != nil {
		publisher.connection.Close()
	}
}
